**Document model** (release-notes/spec style, fits "edit document"):
- meta: title (required), subtitle, doc type (release notes/spec/policy), version, date, status (draft/review/final), author
- sections: ordered array; each section:
  - id, type: "heading" (h2 + paragraphs) — let me define typed section kinds:
    - "text" — heading + paragraphs[]
    - "facts" — heading + key-value pairs[]
    - "list" — heading + items[]
    - "callout" — heading + note text (highlighted box)
- Structure invariants (validation rules):
  1. title non-empty (document has exactly one title)
  2. every section has a heading (non-empty)
  3. every section has ≥1 content block of its type (paragraph ≥1, facts ≥1 pair, list ≥1 item)
  4. document has ≥1 section
  5. list items non-empty
  These make "structure" concrete and checkable.

**Structure-preserving operations** (the API of edits):
- setField (title/metadata) — never affects structure
- setSectionHeading, setParagraph, setListItem, setFactKey/Value — value edits
- addSection(kind, position) — inserts a valid, fully-formed section (template with one valid block)
- removeSection — removes whole section at once (cannot leave orphan/empty shell)
- moveSection up/down — pure reorder
- addParagraph / removeParagraph (guard: keep ≥1)
- addListItem / removeListItem (guard ≥1)
- addFactPair / removeFactPair (guard ≥1)
- Undo/redo stack (time-性 medium → history)
- Reset to initial sample document

Each operation is total on the model → structure can never be broken. avoid: persistent icon toolbars on every card
strategy: generous line-height and measure in the preview reading column
section operations appear on hover/focus so the editor stays calm
single slim toolbar row; no secondary navigation
no loading state: initial document inlined, first paint is ready state

primary: Ordered sections with typed editable fields (editor pane)
Live preview rendering the same document (preview pane)

design_decisions.justification_vs_shape: Cardinality one → one document, one screen, no collection views. Hierarchy medium → document→sections→blocks made visible through ordered cards and mirrored heading levels in preview. Density low → spacious reading column, calm chrome. Relationality low → no cross-links, relations are only composition (document has sections) and derivation (preview renders document). Comparison none → no side-by-side diff or alternate versions. Temporality medium → undo/redo history and 'last edited' timestamp. Volatility medium → every keystroke re-renders preview instantly with no persistence promise; explicit reset/export.

major_choices.choice: Structure-preserving operation API: all mutations are guarded operations (typed section templates on add, cardinality guards on remove, pure reorder) — never free-form source editing
major_choices.rationale: Makes '编辑不破坏结构' true by construction: no operation exists that can produce a broken skeleton; text-level emptiness is allowed but continuously validated and surfaced in both panes.

major_choices.choice: Single model, two derived views (editor and preview render the same state object)
major_choices.rationale: Consistency of 结构化编辑与预览 is guaranteed architecturally, not via sync logic; selection sync (editor↔preview highlight) makes it verifiable.

major_choices.choice: Hybrid guarding: hard guards on structure cardinality (cannot delete last section/block), soft live validation on text emptiness (heading/list item non-empty) with issues shown inline and in a header status pill
major_choices.rationale: Hard-blocking typing would be hostile; letting validation catch content-level issues keeps structure intact while giving honest, visible integrity status.

major_choices.choice: React 18 + Vite, built to a self-contained static dist/index.html (inlined assets) so the deliverable opens statically and is ready at first paint with the inlined sample document
major_choices.rationale: Static single-file output avoids module-CORS issues over file://, satisfies 'no deployment / no external services', and React's derived-render model fits MC-2.

major_choices.choice: Undo/redo history over the operation API (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) plus reset-to-sample
major_choices.rationale: Temporality medium and P-28 recoverable action: every operation is reversible; cheap safety net complements the guards.

primary_structure.pattern: Single-task work surface: slim document header (identity + structure status + recoverable actions) over a two-pane work region — structure editor pane (ordered typed-section cards) | live preview pane (derived rendering with bidirectional selection sync)
rationale: One focused task dominates the product, so PAT-APPLICATION-SHELL reduces to a slim header with no navigation (its own does_not_apply_when)
Structure-preserving edits need the section order and types always visible → ordered cards with type badges (P-01 grouping)

Consistency must be verifiable, not promised → preview derives from the same model and mirrors section structure one-to-one; selection highlights counterpart (H-07/P-26: ready/selected states first-class)
Density low → two calm panes, generous whitespace, operations revealed on hover/focus rather than persistent button rows

primary.reason: Editing happens in typed fields per section block; a form representation with in-place inputs is the safest structure-preserving surface (no syntax to corrupt).

rejected.reason: Raw source editing is exactly what breaks structure; rejected by the user job itself.
Single continuous editing task, no prescribed step sequence.
Spatiality is none; free placement adds structure risk with no benefit.

supporting.reason: Preview is the rendered document itself (paper-like), giving the 'what it looks like' truth that must stay identical to the editor.
Ordered section cards read as a list; ordering is the medium-hierarchy backbone and supports move up/down operations.

content.text: Decide gate returned REVIEW with fixable conflicts: (1) `justification_vs_shape` must live inside `representation`; (2) the pattern must be named by its routed id (PAT-APPLICATION-SHELL, reduced per its own `does_not_apply_when`); (3) major choices need structured `references`. Resubmitting.

avoid: persistent icon toolbars on every card
strategy: generous line-height and measure in the preview reading column
section operations appear on hover/focus so the editor stays calm
single slim header row; no secondary navigation
no loading state: initial document inlined, first paint is ready state

primary: Ordered sections with typed editable fields (editor pane)
Live preview rendering the same document (preview pane)

major_choices.choice: Structure-preserving operation API: all mutations of document/section are guarded operations (typed section templates on add, cardinality guards on remove, pure reorder) — never free-form source editing
major_choices.rationale: Makes the user job success '编辑不破坏结构' true by construction for document and section objects: no operation exists that can produce a broken skeleton; text-level emptiness stays legal but is continuously validated and surfaced on both editor and preview.
references: task:primary=edit one structured document via structure-preserving controls

major_choices.choice: Single model, two derived views: editor and preview render one state object; preview block mirrors each section one-to-one with bidirectional selection highlight
major_choices.rationale: Consistency of structured editing and preview is guaranteed architecturally rather than via two-way sync logic; the selection mirror makes the acceptance seed inspectable at any moment.
references: acceptance_seed=结构化编辑与预览一致

major_choices.choice: Hybrid guarding: hard guards on structure cardinality (cannot delete the last section or a section's last content block), soft live validation for text emptiness (heading/list item non-empty) surfaced inline and in a header structure-status pill
major_choices.rationale: Hard-blocking typing would be hostile; the structure_check object reports content-level issues honestly in both panes while the section skeleton remains unbreakable.

major_choices.choice: React 18 + Vite built to a self-contained static dist/index.html (assets inlined), initial document inlined in the bundle
major_choices.rationale: Satisfies delivery constraints (static open, usable at load, no external services) and MC-2's derived-render model; no backend, no persistence service.
references: constraint=交付物必须能直接静态打开

major_choices.choice: Undo/redo history over the operation API (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) plus reset-to-sample
major_choices.rationale: Temporality medium and recoverable-action principle: every operation is reversible; the cheap safety net complements the cardinality guards.

primary_structure.pattern: PAT-APPLICATION-SHELL, reduced per its own does_not_apply_when ('one focused task dominates the entire product'): a slim document header (identity + structure status + recoverable actions) around one work region split into structure-editor pane (ordered typed-section cards) and live preview pane (derived rendering, bidirectional selection sync)
rationale: Router returned PAT-APPLICATION-SHELL and it was inspected at L1; its does_not_apply_when is satisfied here, so the shell reduces to header + work region with zero navigation chrome
Structure-preserving edits need section order and types always visible → ordered typed cards (P-01 grouping)

Consistency must be verifiable, not promised → preview derives from the same model and mirrors sections one-to-one; selection highlights the counterpart (P-26/H-07: ready and selected states first-class)
Density low → two calm panes, generous whitespace, operations revealed on hover/focus rather than persistent button rows

representation.justification_vs_shape: Cardinality one → one document, one screen, no collection or comparison surfaces. Hierarchy medium → document→sections→blocks expressed as ordered cards and mirrored heading levels in the preview. Density low → spacious reading column and calm chrome. Relationality low → only composition (document has sections) and derivation (preview renders document); no link graph UI. Comparison none → no diff or alternate-version views. Temporality medium → undo/redo plus last-edited time. Volatility medium → every keystroke re-renders the preview instantly; explicit reset/export. The form-primary/document-supporting pairing directly encodes the acceptance seed: fields are the only mutation surface, the document view is the derived truth, so 结构化编辑与预览一致 holds by construction.

primary.reason: Editing happens in typed fields per section block; a form representation with in-place inputs is the safest structure-preserving surface (no syntax to corrupt).

rejected.reason: Raw source editing is exactly what breaks structure; rejected by the user job itself.
Single continuous editing task, no prescribed step sequence.
Spatiality is none; free placement adds structure risk with no benefit.

supporting.reason: Preview is the rendered document itself (paper-like), giving the 'what it looks like' truth that must stay identical to the editor.
Ordered section cards read as a list; ordering is the medium-hierarchy backbone and supports move up/down operations.

major_choices.choice: Structure-preserving operation API: all mutations are guarded operations (typed section templates on add, cardinality guards on remove, pure reorder) — never free-form source editing
major_choices.rationale: Makes the user job success (edits never break structure) true by construction: no operation exists that can produce a broken skeleton; text-level emptiness stays legal but is continuously validated and surfaced on both editor and preview.

major_choices.choice: Single model, two derived views: editor and preview render one state object; each preview block mirrors its section one-to-one with bidirectional selection highlight
major_choices.rationale: Consistency of structured editing and preview is guaranteed architecturally rather than via two-way sync logic; the selection mirror makes the acceptance seed inspectable at any moment.

major_choices.choice: Hybrid guarding: hard guards on structure cardinality (cannot delete the last section or a section's last content block), soft live validation for text emptiness surfaced inline and in a header structure-status pill
major_choices.rationale: Hard-blocking typing would be hostile; the structure check reports content-level issues honestly in both panes while the section skeleton remains unbreakable.

major_choices.choice: React 18 + Vite built to a self-contained static dist/index.html (assets inlined), initial document inlined in the bundle
major_choices.rationale: Satisfies the frozen delivery constraints (static open, usable at load, no external services, no backend) and gives MC-2's derived-render model for free.

major_choices.choice: Undo/redo history over the operation API (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) plus reset-to-sample
major_choices.rationale: Medium temporality and the recoverable-action principle: every operation is reversible; the cheap safety net complements the cardinality guards.

rationale: Router returned Application Shell and it was inspected at L1; its does_not_apply_when ('one focused task dominates the entire product') is satisfied, so the shell reduces to a slim document header (identity + structure status + recoverable actions) around ONE work region — structure-editor pane (ordered typed-section cards) | live preview pane (derived rendering, bidirectional selection sync) — with zero navigation chrome
Structure-preserving edits need section order and types always visible → ordered typed cards (P-01 grouping)

Consistency must be verifiable, not promised → preview derives from the same model and mirrors sections one-to-one; selection highlights the counterpart (P-26/H-07: ready and selected states first-class)
Density low → two calm panes, generous whitespace, operations revealed on hover/focus rather than persistent button rows

representation.justification_vs_shape: cardinality one → one document, one screen, no collection or comparison surfaces. relationality low → only composition (document has sections) and derivation (preview renders document); no link graph UI. hierarchy medium → document→sections→blocks expressed as ordered editor cards and mirrored heading levels in the preview. density low → spacious reading column and calm chrome. temporality medium → undo/redo plus last-edited time. volatility medium → every keystroke re-renders the preview instantly; explicit reset/export. uncertainty low and comparison none → no speculative-state or diff UI; spatiality none → no canvas. dimensionality medium → four typed section kinds. The form-primary/document-supporting pairing encodes the acceptance seed: fields are the only mutation surface, the document view is derived truth, so structured editing and preview stay consistent by construction.

primary.reason: Editing happens in typed fields per section block; a form representation with in-place inputs is the safest structure-preserving surface (no syntax to corrupt).

rejected.reason: Raw source editing is exactly what breaks structure; rejected by the user job itself.
Single continuous editing task, no prescribed step sequence.
Spatiality is none; free placement adds structure risk with no benefit.

supporting.reason: Preview is the rendered document itself (paper-like), giving the 'what it looks like' truth that must stay identical to the editor.
Ordered section cards read as a list; ordering is the hierarchy backbone and supports move up/down operations.

major_choices.rationale: Medium temporality and the recoverable-action principle: every operation is reversible; the cheap safety net complements the cardinality guards.

rationale: Routed and L1-inspected; its does_not_apply_when ('one focused task dominates the entire product') is satisfied, so the shell reduces to a slim document header (identity + structure status + recoverable actions) around ONE work region — structure-editor pane (ordered typed-section cards) | live preview pane (derived rendering, bidirectional selection sync) — with zero navigation chrome
Structure-preserving edits need section order and types always visible → ordered typed cards (perceptual grouping)
Consistency must be verifiable, not promised → preview derives from the same model and mirrors sections one-to-one; selection highlights the counterpart (ready and selected states first-class)
Density low → two calm panes, generous whitespace, operations revealed on hover/focus rather than persistent button rows

representation.justification_vs_shape: cardinality one → one document, one screen, no collection or comparison surfaces. relationality low → only composition (document has sections) and derivation (preview renders document); no link graph UI. hierarchy medium → document→sections→blocks expressed as ordered editor cards and mirrored heading levels in the preview. density low → spacious reading column and calm chrome. temporality medium → undo/redo plus last-edited time. volatility medium → every keystroke re-renders the preview instantly; explicit reset/export. uncertainty low and comparison none → no speculative-state or diff UI; spatiality none → no canvas. dimensionality medium → four typed section kinds. The form-primary/document-supporting pairing encodes the acceptance seed: fields are the only mutation surface, the document view is derived truth, so structured editing and preview stay consistent by construction.

primary.reason: Editing happens in typed fields per section block; a form representation with in-place inputs is the safest structure-preserving surface (no syntax to corrupt).

rejected.reason: Raw source editing is exactly what breaks structure; rejected by the user job itself.
Single continuous editing task, no prescribed step sequence.
Spatiality is none; free placement adds structure risk with no benefit.

supporting.reason: Preview is the rendered document itself (paper-like), giving the 'what it looks like' truth that must stay identical to the editor.
Ordered section cards read as a list; ordering is the hierarchy backbone and supports move up/down operations.

capabilities: guarded operation API over document/section model
needs.product_action: Edit document content only through structure-preserving operations (typed templates, cardinality guards, reorder)
required_experience: No user action can produce an invalid document skeleton
Every structural change is a first-class, reversible operation

resolution.notes: Pure reducer with a closed operation set; UI exposes only those operations. No raw-source surface exists.

needs.product_action: Keep preview exactly consistent with structured editing at all times
required_experience: Preview is rendered from the same in-memory model as the editor
Every edit is visible in the preview immediately, with no refresh

resolution.notes: Editor and preview are two pure views of one React state tree; derivation is total and synchronous.

capabilities: pure validation functions over the model
needs.product_action: Show live structure-integrity status (checks for empty headings/items, minimum counts)
required_experience: Integrity is visible in both panes, not just promised

resolution.notes: Validation is a pure function of the model; results surface in the header pill, the section card, and mirrored markers in the preview.

needs.product_action: Undo/redo any edit operation; reset to the initial document
required_experience: Every operation reversible; mistakes are cheap

resolution.notes: Command-pattern history over the operation API; bounded stack.

needs.product_action: Verify editor↔preview correspondence via bidirectional section selection highlight
required_experience: Clicking a section highlights its preview block and vice versa

resolution.notes: Single selection state owner; both panes subscribe; scroll sync on selection.

needs.product_action: First screen fully usable at page load (inlined initial document, no loading state)

resolution.notes: Initial document is a module-level constant bundled into the static HTML; no network on load.

needs.product_action: Open statically (dist/index.html) with no backend or external services
required_experience: Works from file:// or any static server

resolution.notes: Vite build with inlined assets produces one self-contained HTML file.

needs.product_action: Export/copy the resulting document (Markdown copy, JSON download)
required_experience: One-click copy; deterministic serialization of the model

resolution.notes: Serializers derive from the same model, so exports also cannot drift from the edited structure.

# Struct · 结构化文档编辑器

cell-j08-s08（edit × single-document）：单一结构化文档的编辑应用。
成功标准：**编辑不破坏结构；结构化编辑与预览一致。**

## 运行

```powershell
npm install
npm run build      # 产物：dist/index.html（单文件，可直接双击以 file:// 打开）
npm run preview    # 或本地预览构建产物
npm run dev        # 开发模式
npm run verify     # 模型不变量验证（2000 次随机结构操作）
```

## 设计要点

- **结构保护（MC-1）**：所有编辑都经由带 guard 的封闭操作集（`src/model.js`
  的 `reduceDoc`）——章节按合法模板新增、删除有最小数量保护、移动是纯重排。
  不存在能产生非法骨架的操作；原始源码编辑被有意排除。
- **单一模型（MC-2）**：编辑器与预览是同一状态的两个纯视图，一致性由构造
  保证；点选章节时双向高亮 + 滚动定位，使"一致"随时可被检验。
- **混合防护（MC-3）**：骨架数量由 guard 硬保护；内容空缺（空标题/空条目）
  由实时校验软提示，顶栏"结构检查"与两侧窗格同步呈现。
- **可恢复（MC-5）**：每个操作进历史栈，Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y 撤销重做；重置也可撤销。
- **首屏即 ready**：示例文档内联在打包产物中，页面加载完成即处于可用状态，
  无加载态。

## 结构

```
index.html            入口（开发）
src/main.jsx          挂载
src/App.jsx           界面（顶栏 / 编辑窗格 / 预览窗格）
src/model.js          领域模型：操作 reducer、校验、统计、导出
src/styles.css        设计令牌与样式（WCAG 2.2 AA）
scripts/verify-model.mjs  模型不变量随机验证
dist/index.html       构建产物（单文件，静态可用）
```

content.thinking:
Interesting results — real measurement caught a real quirk of my test assumptions:

1. `tab_traversal_focus_ring` PASS — and the first Tab stop IS the title input (aria-label 文档标题).
2. `keyboard_reach_title` FAIL — because the title input is the FIRST tab stop, and my loop pressed Tab looking for it but started after already tabbing... wait: I blurred, then pressed Tab up to 12 times checking aria-label — but first stop should be 文档标题. Hmm — after `document.activeElement?.blur()`, focus resets to body; first Tab → title input → loop breaks at tabs=1. Why FAIL? The label read: `document.activeElement?.getAttribute("aria-label")` — title input has aria-label="文档标题". First tab stop showed label "文档标题" in the traversal... but blur() may not reset tab position in the same way; after blur, Chrome continues tab order from last position! That's it: after blur, Tab continues from the last focused index (or body→first). Evidently the tab continued from previous position (the 8th stop) — 12 more tabs never hit title (it cycles...). Actually 8 stops ended at an INPUT with empty label (meta version input, since select labels returned concatenated options text). Continuing 12 more tabs: version input → date → author → sections... down into editor fields; 12 tabs wouldn't wrap around to title. So it failed to find it. Fix: `location.reload()`? Simpler: don't blur — the document begins with focus on body; do the title-edit step FIRST before other tabs, or navigate focus deterministically: after blur, `page.goto` again? Cheapest: reorder — do step 2 (title edit) FIRST (fresh page, first Tab = title input), then step 1 (traversal), then steps 3-5. 

But wait — failure 3 (`keyboard_edit_updates_preview`) and 5 (`keyboard_redo`) depend on step 2's typing. Since step 2 focused the wrong element (12th tab landed somewhere in editor fields), typing went into some field; Ctrl+A selected... whatever. h1 unchanged → FAIL. Then undo "restored" trivially (h1 was already 2.4) → PASS (false positive). Redo → typing never happened so h1 stays 2.4 → FAIL. Root cause single: tab-position continuation after blur.

Fix approach: 
- Fresh page load → step A: press Tab once (lands title input, verify label) → Ctrl+A → type 2.5 → check h1 → Ctrl+Z → check h1 → Ctrl+Y → check h1.
- Then reload page for step B: traversal 8 stops (fresh tab order from top).
- Then reload again for step C: tab to preview block (41 stops fresh) → Enter → check selection.

Reload resets tab position deterministically. Update script accordingly. All three segments use fresh loads. This is a test-harness fix, not a product bug — the product behaves correctly (title input IS the first tab stop with proper ring; keyboard editing works when focus actually lands there — proven by traversal stop #1 and by Enter-selection working).

Let me restructure the script: wrap steps in functions: journeyTitle(), journeyTraversal(), journeyPreviewSelect(); each with fresh page.goto.

MEASUREMENT: scripts/keyboard-check.mjs — 6/6 PASS with per-step ISO-timestamped log: first Tab lands on title input with computed 'solid 2px' focus ring; keyboard-only typing updates preview h1 (Aurora 笔记 2.5 更新说明); Ctrl+Z reverts whole typed group to 2.4; Ctrl+Y redoes to 2.5; 8/8 tab stops are interactive elements with solid 2px ring (62 tabbable elements); Tab reached preview block (stop 61/62) and Enter selected both panes. The measurement also drove one product fix: text edits now coalesce into a single undo group per field.
items.source: scripts/keyboard-check.mjs run log (mirrored at evidence/keyboard-run.log), Chrome headless, exit code 0 on final dist build

items.notes: Header (identity+status) > editor pane (primary) > preview pane (primary) > hover-revealed section ops (supporting) matches SDIR importance; preview reading column is the visually calmest region per spacious density intent.
items.source: screenshot review against SDIR region importance

items.notes: SDIR 0.2 representation.primary = form with non-empty reason; supporting = document + list; rejected code_editor/wizard/canvas recorded.
selection owned by header strip per SDIR (single selectedId state in App); preview owned by session (derived, no independent preview state).
SDIR carries the acceptance criterion on operation sequences, structural validity, preview consistency, and first-screen usability; verified empirically (see requirement_alignment).
Budget declared: 3 panels, 4 primary actions, 1 mode, 2 state owners, 1 nav level, 0 filters, 2 new concepts, 1 keyboard contract, 0 mobile conflicts, 3 surfaces; implementation stays within it.

Section delete (5→4) fully restored by Ctrl+Z; delete disabled at minimum cardinality; reset guarded by confirm dialog mentioning undo; text edits coalesce per field so undo strength matches error cost; model fuzz: 2000 random ops never broke skeleton (npm run verify PASS on final build).

Restatement met on final build: from-scratch single-page app; opens statically (file:// AND http verified); usable at load (5 sections/5 cards present at load event, zero loading nodes); structure-preserving edit×document; acceptance seed verified: typed edit appears in preview immediately (old text gone), delete+undo restores, empty-content validation consistent across both panes; no backend/deployment — all evidence from local static server + file://.

content.text:
**Validation gate PASS — phase COMPLETE.** All 11 checks pass; the keyboard check is now receipt-bound (`implementation_current`), evidence current, zero open failures. The work is done — here's the full picture.

---

## Deliverable: Struct · 结构化文档编辑器 (cell-j08-s08, edit × single-document)

A single-page app for editing **one structured document** where every edit goes through a closed, guarded operation API — so the skeleton physically cannot break — and the preview is a second pure view of the same state object, making 结构化编辑与预览一致 true **by construction**, and verifiable via bidirectional selection sync.

**Open it:** `dist/index.html` (167 kB single file, assets inlined) — verified rendering over both `file://` and local http. First screen is fully usable at load (5 sections / 5 editor cards present at the load event, zero loading nodes — the inlined sample document *is* the ready state).

| Acceptance criterion | Verified by |
|---|---|
| 编辑不破坏结构 | `npm run verify`: 2000 random structural ops — skeleton stayed valid; single-section delete is a no-op by guard; new sections are always legal templates |
| 结构化编辑与预览一致 | Real-browser: typed edit appears in preview immediately (old text gone); delete reflects instantly; validation flags identical in both panes |
| 页面加载即可用 | DOM asserted at the `load` event: full content, no loading state exists in the app |

## Prax flow (all gates passed)

`design_start` (greenfield, requirement confirmed from brief.md) → `frame` PASS → `context` + `route` (domain uncovered by the KB; **scope gap explicitly accepted** per the tool's own escape hatch, proceeded on WEB-DESKTOP + Application-Shell-reduced-to-header guidance) → `inspect` L1 ×8 → `decide` PASS (5 major choices, MC-1…MC-5) → `sdir` generated & lint-clean → `reconcile` 8 needs, all supported, 0 gaps → `realize` direct_code → `prepare_implementation` → `validate` plan → submit → evaluate → **COMPLETE**, with a digest-bound 0.2 measurement receipt for the empirical keyboard check.

Two review loops were resolved by reading what the gates asked for rather than around them: the decide gate wanted the exact routed pattern id and lowercase shape tokens in `justification_vs_shape`; the validate gate wanted a schema-valid, digest-bound receipt (I generated it with prax-validator's own `captureImplementation`/`captureContracts` so the recomputed hash matches).

## Real-browser evidence (mandatory, all in `evidence/`)
